description:
OpenJot is an open-source journaling app built with a minimal UI, focused on privacy and simplicity. Everything is stored securely on your device—never in the cloud
Key Features:
• 📝 Rich Text Editing: Express yourself with a powerful editor supporting styles and formatting.
• 🖼️ Media Support: Attach photos, videos, and voice recordings to your entries.
• 🔒 Privacy First: Your data stays on your device. Secure your journal with biometric authentication.
• 📍 Location Tagging: Remember where your memories happened with integrated maps.
• 📂 Save entries as PDF: Save your entries as PDF
• 🎨 Beautiful UI: A clean, distraction-free interface with a focus on typography and ease of use.
OpenJot is completely offline and respects your privacy. No tracking, no cloud syncing, just you and your thoughts.
